watchtower.name: Field Watchtower
watchtower.description: Reliable ranged pressure. The first field-defense baseline.

spike_trap.name: Spike Trap
spike_trap.description: Cheap burst damage and strong knockback when enemies cross it.

field_camp.name: Field Camp
field_camp.description: Creates a small recovery pocket for the Warden during long expeditions.

arcane_pylon.name: Arcane Pylon
arcane_pylon.description: Fast magical turret whose shots can jump to nearby enemies.

palisade.name: Palisade
palisade.description: A simple temporary obstacle zone that slows enemies crossing its footprint.
